name: Sea Palace
surveySource: OSM building=houseboat way w454006714 (the floating restaurant; BAG has no live pand for it) fitted with an oriented rectangle, native east/south metres from its centre. Storey heights, eaves and ornament measured by eye from the 2021 and 2025 municipal panoramas.
modifications: Original texture-free geometry on the OSM houseboat outline: pontoon deck and balustrades, three storeys of columns and glazing, and three curved green-tile eaves with upswept corners; measured by eye from municipal panoramas, no pixels or meshes imported.
